records.subject: three-, two-, and one-dimensional thermoelectric materials
records.quote: We propose the existence of an optimal Seebeck coefficient (S-opt) for three-, two-, and one-dimensional thermoelectric materials.

records.subject: S-opt in the range 130–187 μV/K
records.object: maximum power factor in characterized bulk thermoelectrics
records.quote: This assertion is supported by an exhaustive comparison with experimental data of well characterized bulk thermoelectrics, all of which have shown that the power factor is maximized when S-opt in the range of 130-187 mu V/K.
modality_evidence: This assertion is supported by an exhaustive comparison with experimental data of well characterized bulk thermoelectrics, all of which have shown that the power factor is maximized when S-opt in the range of 130-187 mu V/K.

records.subject: increasing electrical conductivity at the given S-opt

records.conditions: Electrical conductivity should be increased while maintaining the given optimal Seebeck coefficient.
